indices.description:
Contains all commits, pull requests, issues, and comments from the instantsearch repository, sorted  by newest first.

Use this index for general queries and when relevance matters most.
Same content as main index, sorted by oldest first. Use for temporal queries like "oldest commits" or "first issues".
Same content as main index, sorted by most reactions. Use for popularity queries like "most reacted" or "most emojis reactions".
Same content as main index, sorted by highest number of comments. Use for popularity queries like "most discussed issues" or "most debated PRs".
Same content as main index, sorted by most files changes. Use for popularity queries like "biggest big bang PRs" or "biggest refactoring".
Same content as main index, sorted by most deleted lines. Use for popularity queries like "biggest cleanups" or "most deleted content".
